# tailscale_device_authorization (Resource)

The device_authorization resource is used to approve new devices before they can join the tailnet. See https://tailscale.com/kb/1099/device-authorization/ for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tailscale_device" "sample_device" {
  name = "device.example.com"
}

resource "tailscale_device_authorization" "sample_authorization" {
  # Prefer the new, stable `node_id` attribute; the legacy `.id` field still works.
  device_id  = data.tailscale_device.sample_device.node_id
  authorized = true
}

# Delete a device from the tailnet when this resource is destroyed.
# Destroy uses the value stored in state, so apply this setting before
# removing the resource from the configuration.
resource "tailscale_device_authorization" "old_node" {
  device_id         = "nodeidCNTRL"
  authorized        = true
  delete_on_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorized` (Boolean) Whether or not the device is authorized
- `device_id` (String) The device to set as authorized

### Optional

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to delete the device from the tailnet when this resource is destroyed. Defaults to `false`, in which case destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state. Terraform destroys a resource using the values recorded in its state, so this must be set to `true` and applied before the resource is removed from the configuration or destroyed. Changing `device_id` forces replacement, which destroys the resource, so with this set to `true` the previous device is deleted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Device authorization can be imported using the node ID (preferred) or the
# legacy ID. An imported device keeps delete_on_destroy = false until the
# configuration sets it and is applied.
import {
  to = tailscale_device_authorization.old_node
  id = "nodeidCNTRL"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Device authorization can be imported using the node ID (preferred), e.g.,
terraform import tailscale_device_authorization.sample_authorization nodeidCNTRL
# Device authorization can be imported using the legacy ID, e.g.,
terraform import tailscale_device_authorization.sample_authorization 123456789
```
